name: reclip
description: Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
readmeExcerpt:
# ReClip

A self-hosted, open-source video and audio downloader with a clean web UI. Paste links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, and 1000+ other sites — download as MP4 or MP3.




https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/419d3e50-c933-444b-8cab-a9724986ba05



## Features

- Download videos from 1000+ supported sites (via [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp))
- MP4 video or MP3 audio extraction
- Quality/resolution picker
- Bulk downloads — paste multiple URLs at once
- Automatic URL deduplication
- Clean, responsive UI — no frameworks, no build step
- Single Python file backend (~150 lines)

## Quick Start

```bash
brew install yt-dlp ffmpeg    # or apt install ffmpeg && pip install yt-dlp
git clone https://github.com/averygan/reclip.git
cd reclip
./reclip.sh
```

Open **http://localhost:8899**.

Or with Docker:

```bash
docker build -t reclip . && docker run -p 8899:8899 reclip
```

## Usage

1. Paste one or more video URLs into the input box
2. Choose **MP4** (video) or **MP3** (audio)
3. Click **Fetch** to load video info and thumbnails
4. Select quality/resolution if available
5. Click **Download** on individual videos, or **Download All**

## Supported Sites

Anything [yt-dlp supports](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/supportedsites.md), including:

YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Vimeo, Twitch, Dailymotion, SoundCloud, Loom, Streamable, Pinterest, Tumblr, Threads, LinkedIn, and many more.

## Stack

- **Backend:** Python + Flask (~150 lines)
- **Frontend:** Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (single file, no build step)
- **Download engine:** [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) + [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)
- **Dependencies:** 2 (Flask, yt-dlp)

## Disclaimer

This tool is intended for personal use only. Please respect copyright laws and the terms of service of the platforms you download from. The developers are not responsible for any misuse of this tool.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

aiSummary.oneLiner: A user-friendly, self-hosted web interface for downloading media using yt-dlp.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Reclip provides a clean, modern web-based frontend for the popular command-line utility `yt-dlp`. It allows users to easily download videos, audio tracks, and playlists from hundreds of supported websites directly through their browser, eliminating the need to memorize complex terminal commands. The application is designed to be easily self-hosted via Docker, acting as a centralized media downloader for a home network. It features a responsive UI, download queue management, format selection (e.g., MP4 vs MP3 extraction), and persistent storage configurations, making bulk media archiving highly accessible to non-technical users.
keyFeatures: Web-based frontend: Replaces complex `yt-dlp` terminal commands with a clean, responsive, and intuitive graphical user interface.
Broad site support: Inherits the massive site compatibility of the underlying `yt-dlp` engine, supporting YouTube, Vimeo, Twitter, and hundreds more.
Format selection: Allows users to easily select desired video resolutions, framerates, or extract audio-only formats (like MP3) directly from the UI.
Dockerized deployment: Provides a simple `docker-compose` setup for effortless self-hosting on home servers or NAS devices.
Download queue management: Supports queuing multiple links or entire playlists for background processing without keeping the browser open.

useCases.title: Home Media Archiving
useCases.description: Data hoarders deploy the app on their Unraid or Synology NAS to easily archive YouTube playlists directly to their local Plex media storage.

useCases.title: Audio Extraction
useCases.description: Music producers use the web interface to quickly paste links and extract high-quality audio stems from online videos for sampling.

useCases.title: Non-Technical Downloading
useCases.description: Tech-savvy users set up the service for their less technical family members, allowing them to download web videos without touching a command line.

useCases.title: Offline Viewing Prep
useCases.description: Travelers queue up dozens of educational videos or documentaries to download overnight before a long flight without internet access.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Self-hosters, data hoarders, and anyone who wants a simple web interface for downloading online media without using the command line.
